Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the PGT/TGT/Instructor posts at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala is scheduled for 28 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue as per the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala includes various posts such as PGT (Physics, Computer Science), TGT (Maths, Sanskrit, Science), Special Educator, ATL Instructor, Sports Teacher/Coach, Vocational Teacher/Instructor, Self-Defence Instructor, Yoga Teacher, and Counselor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for these positions?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates varies depending on the post. Some positions offer a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 25,000 or Rs. 10,000, while others will be paid as per KVS PM SHRI rules.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: For PGT posts, candidates generally need a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks and a B.Ed degree with 50% marks or equivalent qualification as per NCTE norms. Specific qualifications may vary for PGT (Computer Science).

faq.question: Q6. Is CTET qualification mandatory for TGT posts?
faq.answer: Yes, for TGT (Maths), TGT (Sanskrit), and TGT (Science) posts, candidates must possess a Bachelor/Honours Degree with 50% marks, a B.Ed degree with 50% marks, and have qualified CTET Paper-II.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala primarily involves an Interview. Document verification will also be conducted as part of the selection procedure.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala office. Candidates are advised to confirm the exact venue and reporting time from the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The positions advertised by PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Ambala are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions specified in the appointment letter.
